vehicle_name: MG4 EV 51 kWh - Partially Sourced Reference

sourced_fields.nominal_pack_energy_kwh: 51 kWh LFP battery (Standard Range), MG Motor official spec sheet
sourced_fields.rated_range_km_reference: 350 km claimed range for MG4 51 kWh RWD, secondary source (zecar.com listing); the test cycle is not stated and India ARAI certification is pending, so no cycle label is claimed

assumptions: Usable energy fraction of 0.90 is illustrative
Vehicle mass of 2100 kg is an inherited placeholder, far above the class; a verified MG4 kerb mass is roughly 1600-1700 kg and must be sourced before calibration
Drag coefficient and frontal area are unverified assumptions
Rolling resistance and drivetrain efficiency are unverified assumptions
Regenerative braking parameters are unverified assumptions
Auxiliary load, HVAC load and rotational inertia factor are illustrative
provenance.note: For pipeline testing only. MG markets the car globally as MG4 EV (no separate India trim name verified as of the retrieval date); a 64 kWh Long Range variant claims ~450-452 km WLTP. Do not present the calculated range as a validated MG4 EV prediction.
